calculation.description: Twenty-session momentum is scaled by directional persistence: consistently positive daily returns retain positive momentum, while inconsistent or predominantly negative paths reverse or attenuate the signal. Values are computed using data available through the decision date and evaluated against forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate daily paper IC and ICIR at the required 10-day horizon across the 15-asset universe. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty; broad coverage supports implementation. Predictive strength decays materially by 40 days.
